title: Korean header text wraps at spaces only: Malgun Gothic 11 in the 468 pt column breaks into two lines ending at spaces, a 12-syllable word kept whole, pitch 18.96
source: probe build.py -> Word for Mac direct PDF (2026-10-29), pymupdf: Letter 1440 margins, header 720, docDefaults Calibri 11; Malgun Gothic 11 run of 64 hangul characters with 11 spaces: line 1 ends after a space at x 531.95, line 2 at 364.96, baselines 50.16 / 69.12 (pitch 18.96 = 11 x 1.7237), body top 73.97 = 36 + 2 x 18.96; w:wordWrap=0 gave the same two lines (no syllable fits in the 8 pt left). gen's strip paragraphs had no word-break rule, so Chromium's UAX#14 default could break between syllables

cases.note: w:wordWrap=0 allows character wrapping (Word's default rule off)
